test_decode_utf8_single_char: test decode_utf8 to decode a single UTF-8 byte sequence like the Euro sign into code points
test_decode_utf8_multiple_chars: test decode_utf8 to decode a string with multiple UTF-8 characters including ASCII and multi-byte sequences
test_decode_utf8_incomplete_sequence: test decode_utf8 handling of an incomplete UTF-8 sequence and verify the PartialUTF8 state
test_decode_utf8_continue_sequence: test decode_utf8 continuation of a previously incomplete UTF-8 sequence using a PartialUTF8 state object
test_decode_utf8_empty_string: test decode_utf8 handling of an empty byte string and verify it returns an empty code point list
